entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Merge dotnetup getting started documentation to main #55509
  • Thread the project's C# LangVersion through the source-generator-hosted rzc discover path #55508
  • NETSDK1094 during ResolveReadyToRunCompilers despite PublishReadyToRun in Directory.Build.props #55507
  • Running `/t:Clean;Build` suppresses NuGet warnings #55505
  • `Queue Tests` build step performs redundant NuGet restore, adding significant overhead to CI #55504
  • Eliminate Native AOT warnings from MSBuild-backed CLI commands #55501
  • TestTemplatesCG fails in internal official scheduled build with MSB4057 (RunTests target missing) #55496
  • Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.IntegrationTests RegistryTests.CanReadManifestFromRegistry: flaky failure - CONTAINER1014 Manifest pull failed (external registry BadRequest) #55495
  • Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Razor.Tool.Tests Dispatcher_ProcessSimultaneousConnections_HitsKeepAliveTimeout: intermittent hang (test host hang-dump timeout, exit code 7) #55494
  • WebApplicationFactory integration tests fail on .NET SDK 10.0.302 with FileNotFoundException for ASP.NET Core hosting assemblies #55492
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With 11.0.100-preview.7.26376.106.exe installed, wasm-tools workload installation failed with 11.0.100-preview.7.26376.106 of package microsoft.netcore.app.runtime.browser-wasm.msi.-x64 not found #55491
  • [NETSDKE2E] The implicit runtime (8.0/9.0/10.0) for NET11 preview 7 should be July update(8.0.29/9.0.18/10.0.10). #55490
  • BlazorWebAssemblyDiagnosticsEnabled cannot be set from a .csproj (conditions evaluated in Sdk.props) #55489
  • dotnet watch: Mac Catalyst hot-reload agent WebSocket drops before the first edit; updates fail but watch reports "changes applied" #55488

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E]Publishing blazorwasm project failed with AOT compilation = true after upgrading to .NET 6.0.318(Oct update) #35645
  • restore failing on Alpine arm32 #35676
  • dotnet restore fails when .dcproj is part of solution #35134
  • Add Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.Metrics to the list of default usings for ASP.NET Core applications #34813
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55424
  • Cannot publish a project with top-level statements if an output directory is specified #55295

PullRequests

Created

  • Prototype outline for `dotnetup` self update mechanism #55511
  • Add a skill for authoring .NET analyzers #55510
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55506
  • Add --prerelease flag to dotnet new install #55503
  • Fix duplicate runtime pack crash in `dotnet test` device deployment #55502
  • Unify internal CI matrix and refactor CG mode to SDL mode #55500
  • Add pre-MSBuild submission duration metric #55499
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55497
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Harden MTP artifact post-processing and add an opt-out #55493
    backport
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #55486
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Fix missing data for ReportInstallSucces #55485
    Servicing-approved, backport

Merged

  • [main] Fix missing data for ReportInstallSucces #55487
    backport
  • Host the Razor source generator in rzc (opt-in generate/discover) #55422
  • Add Native AOT infrastructure for MSBuild evaluation #55441

    Approved to merge, backport
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55465
  • Harden MTP artifact post-processing and add an opt-out #55480
